newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed in a slower trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed in a slower trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed in a slower trade on Wednesday with blue chips continuing their climb.
* Five of 13 active issues rose, four fell and four were flat.
* Volume dipped to 8,194 shares from 12,074 on Tuesday and turnover was also lower at 5.5 million kuna.
* Biggest gainer was brewery Karlovacka Pivovara climbing 25 kuna to 290 on volume of 161 shares.
* Leading decliner was Jadranturist which lost 13 kuna to 290 selling 201 shares.
* Most actively traded issue was fully listed Pliva pharmaceutical, adding 14 kuna to 474 kuna on volume of 2,501.
